name: separation-shooter
comment: X-28. Three roles, three places, and the shooter starts OUTSIDE its own hold distance.
The pin X-22 shipped is gone: X-63 found every Dustbowl spawn point is team-owned, so
-SpawnIndex now starves a team and VOIDS a run rather than pinning one. Separation has
to come from the programme, and this set is that.
The withdraw step is the whole point of acceptance criterion 5. Same-team clients spawn
about 3 m apart, which is inside holdDistanceMeters 6.0, so ApproachMoveZ returns 0 from
the first frame and the driver never moves -- the 1.5..3.3 m spread earlier runs reported
was spawn jitter, not an approach. Walking backwards for 10 s while still facing the
target puts real distance in front of the approach, so aim.distanceM at the 'approaching'
capture (a checkpoint fires at its step's ENTRY) is the evidence that ApproachMoveZ was
non-zero on that step's first frame.
Grade acceptance criterion 4 from the server's shot log: run with -LogShots, which sets
IRONFRONT_LOG_SHOTS=1 and makes ServerCombatBridge print the nearest OTHER target beside
every trigger frame. That line is the only artifact that says whether the resolver picked
the intended target or the witness.
